title: Move the MFA app to a new phone

character.name: Aleena
character.personality: organised, upgrading her phone this weekend

symptom: User is getting a new phone and wants to keep using her authenticator app
user_description: I'm getting a new phone this weekend. How do I move my authenticator app so I don't get locked out?

options.why: Wiping first can lock her out because the app and its codes disappear with it.

options.text: Take a screenshot of the QR code and email it to herself
options.why: Anyone who can see the screenshot can generate her codes. It exposes the secret.

options.text: Add the new phone as a sign-in method while the old phone still works, or use the app's backup and transfer feature, before wiping the old phone
options.why: Doing it while the old phone still works means she is never locked out. Using the app's built-in features moves the secret safely.

options.text: Turn off MFA until she has settled in
options.why: Removes protection from her account during a vulnerable time.

hints: What must still work while you move the app?
Why is a screenshot of a QR code dangerous?
In what order should she do things?
real_world_tip: Tell her not to wipe or trade in the old phone until she has proved the new one works.
